about_the_game:
Demo Description:

This is the official demo for "Salary-Mon | Hiro vs His Demons." It offers a complete and polished introduction to Hiro's world and the core gameplay mechanics, covering everything up to the end of the game's tutorial.

In this demo, you will:

  • Experience the Introduction: Meet Hiro Kaiho and witness the pivotal moment when his life changes, as he encounters his spiritual guardian and the inner demons that plague him.

  • Learn the Basics: The demo will guide you through the initial gameplay loop, teaching you how to navigate the melancholic streets of Tokyo and understand the game's unique psychological narrative.

  • Engage in First Combat: You'll be introduced to the game's central "Poke-like" turn-based combat system. This is your chance to learn how to use Hiro's "tools of self-improvement" like Discipline and Wisdom to battle one of his inner demons.

  • See the World: Get a taste of the game's beautiful 16-bit style pixel graphics and its haunting, atmospheric soundtrack.

This demo is designed to be a short but compelling glimpse into the emotional and strategic experience of the full game. It's a vertical slice that showcases the core loop and unique premise without giving away the full story.

Key Features of the Demo:

  • Narrative Intro: A full-featured, cinematic introduction to the story and characters.

  • Strategic Combat: Experience a single, complete turn-based battle against one of Hiro's demons.

  • Progression & Abilities: Get a first look at how Hiro's abilities and resolve can grow.

  • Beautiful Aesthetics: Enjoy the full, polished visuals and soundtrack of the game's early stages.

Note: This demo is a self-contained experience that focuses on the tutorial. While it accurately represents the look, feel, and core mechanics of the full game, it does not include the full range of abilities, locations, or story progression. The full game will feature a deeper combat system with more skills, a wider variety of demons, and a rich, psychological storyline that unfolds across many hours of gameplay.
